name: AeroRIT
description: Aerial hyperspectral scene over the Rochester Institute of Technology campus, with pixel-wise semantic labels for roads, buildings, vegetation, cars, and water.
citation: Rangnekar, A., Mokashi, N., Ientilucci, E., Kanan, C., & Hoffman, M. J. (2020). AeroRIT: A New Scene for Hyperspectral Image Analysis. IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, 58(11), 8116–8124. https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.08178
